run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T01:27:09Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is a symptom at the edge. Observed failure path: a chaos-mesh network fault is applied every minute from 01:27:03 onward to the pods quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv; shipping's HTTP client span 'POST quote' to the quote service ends in 'Timeout' at a fixed ~5.00s, shipping's '/get-quote' returns 500 'Internal Server Error', checkout's PlaceOrder fails with gRPC status 13 ('shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500'), frontend's 'POST /api/checkout' returns HTTP 500, and frontend-proxy's 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' spans record HTTP 500. The quote application itself shows fast server spans (calculate-quote entirely within the <=10ms bucket) and no ERROR-status spans, and all otel-demo pods are Running/ready with 0 restarts, so the failures are consistent with a network-level fault between shipping and quote rather than application, pod or resource failure. The exact chaos action and direction could not be read (chaos-mesh CRDs are not queryable) and the only direct evidence for the faulting object is Kubernetes events, so the conclusion is partial.

claims.text: At 01:27:09 the frontend-proxy span error rate was 0.0111 spans/s (STATUS_CODE_ERROR) against 20.41 spans/s of STATUS_CODE_UNSET, i.e. errors were still near the pre-incident level at the moment the alert started.

frontend-proxy error spans occur only on the two operations 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'; their error-span rate rose from 0.0074-0.0185/s in the 01:04-01:27 samples to 0.0444/s at 01:28:09, 0.2667/s at 01:29:09, ~0.48-0.49/s at 01:32-01:38 and ~0.90/s at 01:42-01:43, so the deviation began between the 01:27:09 and 01:28:09 samples.

Trace 925ee26147ff69ef34318fad699a2701 shows the failing chain through visible parent references: load-generator 'POST' error with http.status_code 500 -> frontend-proxy 'ingress' error 500 (5.013877s) -> frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' error 500 -> frontend 'POST /api/checkout' error 500 -> frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' grpc status 13 -> checkout 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' status 13 with description 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' -> shipping '/get-quote' error 'Internal Server Error' -> shipping 'POST quote' error 'Timeout' after 5.001645s.

In the same trace, checkout's calls to cart (HGET, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart), currency (Currency/Convert) and product-catalog (oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct) all returned rpc.grpc.status_code '0', so those dependencies were answering successfully on the failing request path.

The sampled shipping error spans for 01:25:00-01:44:35 are on operations '/get-quote' (otel.status_description 'Internal Server Error') and 'POST quote' (otel.status_description 'Timeout'), each with duration about 5.00s (e.g. 5001856us, 5001645us), i.e. a fixed ~5-second client timeout.

Error-span rate by service over 00:27:09-01:44:35 showed simultaneous deviation for frontend (peak 1.94/s at 01:34), frontend-proxy (peak 0.97/s), checkout (peak 0.96/s) and shipping (peak 0.97/s), while accounting and payment stayed at 0 for every sample in the window.

Kubernetes events show a chaos-mesh Schedule named otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) spawning NetworkChaos objects every minute at 01:27:03, 01:28:03, 01:29:03, 01:30:03, 01:31:03, 01:32:03, 01:33:03, 01:34:03, 01:35:03 and 01:36:03 (reason Spawned, message 'Create new object: otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition-<suffix>').

Each spawned NetworkChaos reports reason Started and then 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w' and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv', followed about 55s later (at :58 of the same minute) by reason TimeUp ('Time up according to the duration') and 'Successfully recover chaos' for those same two pods; PodNetworkChaos objects for quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv were updated in otel-demo at each cycle.

The quote service recorded no ERROR-status spans in 00:27:09-01:44:35 (its three span series POST /getquote, calculate-quote and {closure} carry STATUS_CODE_UNSET only), while its call rate fell from ~0.55-0.64/s in the 01:27-01:30 samples to ~0.085-0.096/s in the 01:32-01:41 samples, matching the chaos cycles that isolate its pod from shipping.

Every duration bucket of quote's 'calculate-quote' operation up to le=10.0 carries the same value as the +Inf bucket (e.g. 0.56296/s at the 01:24:09 sample), so all observed calculate-quote spans completed in 10ms or less; quote's own processing was not slow.

The 100 newest quote container log lines returned (01:26:10-01:36:58) are all the informational line 'Calculated quote', and after 01:27:01 they cluster in short bursts near :58-:03 of each minute instead of the continuous ~40 lines/minute seen at 01:26.

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running and ready with restart count 0, including quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w (started 2026-11-17T00:50:21Z) and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv (started 2026-11-17T00:50:20Z), and no pod-level failure events exist for otel-demo in the window apart from PodNetworkChaos updates.

The email service recorded no ERROR-status spans; its span rate was 2.25/s at 01:27:09, 0.34/s at 01:32 and 01:37, and 0.1/s at 01:42, and no email span appears in the failing trace, so the 'email service' wording in checkout's error text is not backed by observed email failures.

The flagd-config ConfigMap (key demo.flagd.json) currently has every fault flag at defaultVariant 'off' (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) and contains no flag for a quote or shipping network fault.

ad, fraud-detection and recommendation each show a tiny pre-existing error-span rate (~0.0037/s) both before the 01:27:09 alert time and during the incident, i.e. background noise unrelated to this burst.

The shipped fault is a chaos-mesh network partition or loss between shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv and quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w: shipping's client span times out at a fixed ~5s while quote's server spans stay sub-10ms and quote's completed-request rate drops, which fits dropped or delayed packets rather than slow application code; the exact NetworkChaos action and direction are unverified because the chaos-mesh CRD objects could not be read.

The string 'failed POST to email service' in checkout's and shipping's error description is shipping's own message template for a non-200 reply from its quote call, not evidence of an email-path fault: the failing child span in the same trace is shipping's 'POST quote', no email span is present in the trace, and email recorded no error spans.

Quote application slowness or errors as the cause: rejected because all quote 'calculate-quote' durations fell inside the <=10ms bucket, quote emitted no ERROR-status spans, and its pod logged only 'Calculated quote' lines with restart count 0.

Pod crash, OOM, eviction or restart of the involved services: rejected because all otel-demo pods are Running/ready with restart count 0 and there are no Pod failure events in otel-demo for the window.

A flagd feature-flag fault injection as the cause: the flagd-config ConfigMap holds no flag for a quote/shipping network partition and every listed fault flag is at defaultVariant 'off' (state read after the window, so this weakens rather than excludes a flag-based cause).

Suspend or delete the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) and inspect the NetworkChaos spec it generates (action, direction, selector, duration) to confirm which pods and traffic flows it partitions before further remediation.

Confirm the alert has cleared once the chaos cycles stop by re-checking frontend-proxy, checkout and shipping error-span rates, since the span-metric series returned data only up to the 01:44:09 sample and the state after that instant is unknown.

gaps: The NetworkChaos and Schedule custom resources could not be read because chaos-mesh CRDs are not among the queryable kinds, so the partition's action (loss/delay/partition), direction and selector exist only as event messages; the exact fault semantics are unverified.

Chaos evidence stops at 01:36:31 (last returned event), while frontend-proxy error span rate was still ~0.90/s in the 01:43:09 sample; whether further chaos cycles ran until ~01:43 is not confirmed by events.

The last span-metric sample is at 01:44:09 and an instant query at 01:44:35 returned no data (status no_data), so the current/recovered state of the alert and of frontend-proxy error rate could not be established.

list_prometheus_rules returned nothing for rule name RequestErrorRate (status no_data) and for type=alert (status no_data), so the alert's expression and its reported value 0.6444444444444444 could not be reproduced or tied to a specific metric; the alert's exact evaluation window is unknown.
No change-history integration is available, so who or what created Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition and when (before 01:27:03) cannot be verified.

A query for networkpolicies in namespace otel-demo returned no rows (status no_data), so a policy-based network cause can be neither confirmed nor excluded by that query; the chaos events are the named cause.

Service-level coverage is incomplete: cart, currency, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, product-catalog and quote had no error-rate series of their own in the by-service error query; cart, currency and product-catalog were only observed to succeed in the single sampled trace.
The shipping span sample (c5a06a39-51d1-4023-abe5-41ef9f5da98a-t0:3b030a6e-6520-4fc3-9c39-919deed7339b) is truncated and incomplete, so it covers only the 30 rows read and not all 343 error spans.

The quote pod log stream (f11e9c5c-b89c-42e9-9dba-c82187a9c68c-t1:6a1f5953-e4b5-431c-83df-1cf7bfe7e00c) is incomplete and covers 01:26:10-01:36:58 only, and previous-container logs were unavailable, so quote behaviour outside that range is unknown.

The filtered shipping pod log view (c739a693-3182-41cc-b17e-86a86b6d62db-t1:fc36e313-7689-41f9-bec9-040cb6d799cc) is incomplete: it shows the newest 80 of 983 matching lines, so earlier shipping log lines in the window were not read.
next_steps: Read the NetworkChaos/Schedule custom resources in namespace chaos-mesh (otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition and its spawned children) with a tool that can list those CRDs, to confirm the action, direction and selector of the fault.

Inspect chaos-mesh change history or creation records for Schedule otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition once a change-history source is available, to establish who or what introduced the experiment before 01:27:03.
Re-query frontend-proxy, checkout and shipping error-span rates after the chaos cycles stop to confirm the alert clears and establish current service health.
Verify the alert rule definition behind RequestErrorRate in Alertmanager or the Prometheus rule store, since list_prometheus_rules returned no rule set for this environment.

Acknowledge the exposed signal is at the edge (frontend-proxy ingress/egress 500s) and review whether shipping's ~5s quote timeout and error template should be tuned so that partition symptoms surface as timeouts rather than misleading 'failed POST to email service' text.
